issues.description: The solution query for Aufgabe 07 does not include a join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad, causing a Cartesian product of all Gemeinden with all Freibäder. The problem statement asks for the names of Gemeinden that have a "Freibad" and the names of the respective Freibäder (i.e., matching pairs). The provided solution (missing the join) therefore contradicts the problem requirement and would produce incorrect/ misleading results for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to explicitly join Gemeinde and Schwimmbad on the municipality key and filter for Freibad, for example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde JOIN Schwimmbad ON Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This ensures each Gemeinde is paired only with its own Freibäder as required by the task.
